pin_kind: SHA-256 of official fetched section, not an immutable upstream release
accepted_semantics: turn/interrupt ends active turn with interrupted status
thread/resume uses the existing thread ID
experimental dynamic tools persist in rollout metadata and are restored on resume
local_protocol: JSON schema generated from the already-installed bundled executable before the attempt
